Consider this C code to swap two integers and these five statements: the code

  void swap (int *px, int *py)

     }

S5: may add or subtract integers and pointers

questions.question:
Consider the table employee(empId, name, department, salary) and the two queries $Q_1, \, Q_2$ below. Assuming that department $5$ has more than one employee, and we want to find the employees who get higher salary than anyone in the department $5,$ which one of the statements is TRUE for any arbitrary employee table?

$Q_1:$ 
Select e.empId
From employee e
Where not exists
    (Select * From employee s Where s.department = "5" and s.salary >= e.salary)
$Q_2:$ 
Select e.empId
From employee e
Where e.salary > Any
    (Select distinct salary From employee s Where s.department = "5")

questions.title: GATE EE 2019 | EE Question: 26
questions.subject: Electrical Machines
questions.question: A 4-pole, $50\text{ Hz}$, 3-phase induction motor runs at a rotor speed of $1440\text{ rpm}$. The synchronous speed is $1500\text{ rpm}$. The percentage slip $s$ of the motor is ________ percent.
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Electrical Machines):

Synchronous speed $N_s = \frac{120 f}{P} = \frac{120 \times 50}{4} = 1500\text{ rpm}$. Slip $s = \frac{N_s - N}{N_s} \times 100\% = \frac{1500 - 1440}{1500} \times 100\% = \frac{60}{1500} \times 100\% = 4.0\%$.

questions.title: GATE EE 2019 | EE Question: 27
questions.subject: Electrical Machines
questions.question: A $10\text{ kVA}$, $2000/200\text{ V}$, $50\text{ Hz}$ single-phase transformer has full-load iron loss of $150\text{ W}$ and full-load copper loss of $250\text{ W}$. The maximum efficiency occurs at a fraction $x$ of full load equal to ________ (rounded off to two decimal places).
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Electrical Machines):

Maximum efficiency occurs when variable copper loss equals constant iron loss: $x^2 P_{cu} = P_i \implies x = \sqrt{\frac{P_i}{P_{cu}}} = \sqrt{\frac{150}{250}} = \sqrt{0.6} \approx 0.7746 = 0.77$ of full load.

questions.title: GATE EE 2019 | EE Question: 34

questions.question: A $400\text{ kV}$, 3-phase lossless transmission line has total series inductance $L = 1.0\text{ mH/km}$ and shunt capacitance $C = 0.01\,\mu\text{F/km}$. The surge impedance $Z_c = \sqrt{L/C}$ (in Ohms) of the line is ________.

questions.title: GATE EE 2019 | EE Question: 49
questions.subject: Power Electronics & Drives
questions.question: A single-phase full-wave controlled bridge rectifier is fed from a $230\text{ V}$ (RMS), $50\text{ Hz}$ AC source. The firing angle is $\alpha = 60^\circ$. Assuming continuous conduction, the average DC output voltage $V_{dc} = \frac{2 V_m}{\pi} \cos \alpha$ (in Volts) is ________ (round off to one decimal place).
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Power Electronics & Drives):

$V_m = 230 \times \sqrt{2} = 325.27\text{ V}$. $V_{dc} = \frac{2 V_m}{\pi} \cos(60^\circ) = \frac{2 \times 325.27}{\pi} \times 0.5 = \frac{325.27}{3.1416} = 103.54\text{ V}$.
